# Automate Your Inbox Triage With One Rule File

A short, synthetic guide used by the smoke tests. It shows the hub inputs the publisher takes: a one-sentence description, build items, audience items, a navigation note and two steps.

## Description

Set up a rule file that sorts every incoming email into three queues and drafts a reply for the one that matters, in under an hour.

## What You'll Build

- A rule file with three queues: reply today, read this week, archive
- A draft-reply step that never sends on its own
- A daily digest that lists what was archived

## Who This Is For

- Anyone answering more than 40 emails a day by hand
- Small teams sharing one support inbox
- People who tried filters and gave up when they broke

## Navigation

Start at Step 1 unless you already have an API key for your mail provider, in which case skip to Step 2.
